name: B10-0393/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Case of Victoire Ingabire in Rwanda
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Victoire Ingabire in Rwanda
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for Rwanda to release Victoire Ingabire, an opposition leader arrested again in June 2025, along with other party members and journalists held on what it calls abusive charges. It wants Rwanda to investigate the deaths or disappearances of five party members since 2017. It also asks the European Union to press Rwanda on human rights, to stop cooperation on critical raw materials, and to suspend support for Rwandan justice institutions involved in abuses.

- The Parliament asks Rwanda to free Ingabire and other detained opposition members and journalists.
- It asks the European Union to halt raw materials cooperation and suspend support for abusive justice bodies.
- These are requests, not decisions; the Parliament cannot release anyone itself.
